answer: Proof of Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with collateral, ensuring each entity has a measurable cost to forge a fake identity. Like a cryptographically signed cipher securing network states, this model forces attackers to burn capital, akin to chasing a fleeting raven or a comet across a distributed ledger. An adversary must own significant assets to gain consensus power, making the financial barrier to entry prohibitive for cheap, massive identity replication.
